{{recipesummary|category=Chicken recipes|servings=4–6|time=4–8 hours|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Meat|Meats]] | [[Cookbook:Game|Game]] | [[Cookbook:Poultry|Poultry]]
==Ingredients==
* 1 whole [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cut up
* 1 can (10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) condensed cream of chicken soup
* 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of celery soup

==Procedure==
# Put chicken in crock pot.
# Mix together cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.
# Pour soup mixture over chicken in crock pot.
# Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* May substitute game birds.
* May substitute chicken breasts for the whole chicken parts.
* For camping, may cook in a [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] or in a [[Cookbook:Bean pot|bean pot]] in a hole lined with coals and left all day.
